phases.name: Intake
phases.produces: The request, the authorization when there will be internal work, and an inventory of accounts without passwords

phases.name: External diagnosis
phases.produces: Every EXT and VIS check in one of the seven states, and the main findings by priority

phases.name: Internal diagnosis
phases.produces: Every INT check in a state, and the decision between ordinary work and the incident runbook

phases.name: Plan
phases.produces: The order of changes, what will not be touched, a low-traffic window and a written way back

phases.name: Execution
phases.produces: One change at a time, each followed by the post-change matrix, and every SEG and VEL check fixed or passed

phases.name: Verification
phases.produces: The phase 1 and 2 measurements repeated with the same tool and conditions, as a before and after table

phases.name: Handover
phases.produces: The before and after report, ordered access, a short manual and a record of what was delivered

phases.name: Monitoring
phases.produces: The weekly, fortnightly and monthly tasks, and a monthly report

items.title: HTTP security headers
items.question: Does the site tell the browser how to protect visitors?
items.where: Response headers of the home and one inner page
items.pass: HSTS with a max-age of at least 15552000 and nosniff are present; Referrer-Policy and frame protection are set
items.ifFails: Add them at the server or the CDN; start a Content-Security-Policy in Report-Only mode
items.doNotTouch: A strict Content-Security-Policy breaks page builders that inline their scripts

items.title: Version disclosure
items.question: Can anyone see which CMS and plugin versions the site runs?
items.where: HTML, the feed, readme.html and ?ver= parameters
items.pass: No generator tag with a version; readme.html answers 403 or 404; no ?ver= reveals a plugin with a known flaw
items.ifFails: Hide the generator tag, block readme.html and update what is exposed

items.title: User enumeration
items.question: Can anyone list the account names?
items.where: The REST users endpoint and author archives
items.pass: The REST API lists no users to anonymous visitors; ?author=N does not reveal a login name
items.ifFails: Block enumeration through REST and through author archives
items.doNotTouch: Do not disable the whole REST API: the editor needs it

items.title: Sensitive files exposed
items.question: Are private files reachable by anyone?
items.where: A fixed list at the site root: config backups, .env, .git/config, debug.log, database dumps, phpinfo pages
items.pass: Every path answers 403 or 404
items.ifFails: Remove or deny them; a config backup that answered 200 opens the incident runbook

items.title: SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX
items.question: Can someone send mail pretending to be the domain?
items.where: TXT and MX records of the domain
items.pass: SPF present without +all; DMARC present (p=none with rua to start measuring); DKIM valid
items.ifFails: Publish SPF with ~all and DMARC p=none with rua, then move to quarantine
items.doNotTouch: Do not change MX without knowing who receives the mail

items.title: Dangling CNAME
items.question: Are there abandoned subdomains someone could take over?
items.pass: No CNAME points at an unclaimed resource
items.ifFails: Delete the CNAME or claim the resource

items.title: TLS and certificate expiry
items.question: Is the padlock valid and not about to expire?
items.pass: Full chain; expires in more than 15 days; no TLS 1.0 or 1.1
items.ifFails: Renew or install the full chain; require TLS 1.2 or newer

items.title: Field Core Web Vitals on mobile
items.question: How fast do real visitors see the page on a phone?
items.where: PageSpeed Insights field data (Chrome UX Report), mobile
items.pass: LCP under 2.5 s, INP under 200 ms and CLS under 0.1 in field data
items.ifFails: Follow the speed list (VEL)

items.title: Server version disclosure
items.question: Does the server announce its software and version?
items.pass: No exact version in either header
items.ifFails: Ask the host to hide versions

items.title: Directory listing
items.question: Can folders be browsed as a list?
items.pass: No folder lists its contents
items.ifFails: Turn directory indexes off, or add an empty index file per folder

items.title: XML-RPC and pingback
items.question: Is the old remote publishing endpoint open?
items.pass: xmlrpc.php answers 403 or 404, or its use is known and protected
items.ifFails: Block it at the server or with the security plugin, unless something uses it
items.doNotTouch: Do not block it while Jetpack or the mobile app uses it

items.title: Cloaking and conditional redirects
items.question: Does the site show something else to Google or to phones?
items.where: The home fetched with a desktop, a crawler and a phone user agent
items.pass: Same content for all three, with differences of layout only
items.ifFails: Treat it as a sign of compromise and open the incident tab

items.title: Domain expiry and registrar lock
items.question: Is the domain about to expire or unlocked?
items.where: RDAP, or the registry's own lookup where there is no RDAP
items.pass: Expires in more than 60 days; auto-renewal on or a named person responsible
items.ifFails: Renew; turn on auto-renewal and two-factor at the registrar

items.title: Old copies and staging exposed
items.question: Are forgotten old copies of the site published?
items.where: /old/, /backup/ and similar paths; staging, dev and test subdomains; a site: search
items.pass: No old copy answers or is indexed
items.ifFails: Delete or password-protect them; add noindex; request removal

items.title: Open redirect parameters
items.question: Could a link on the site send visitors anywhere?
items.where: redirect, url, next and return parameters in the HTML
items.pass: No open redirect parameters, or they validate the target
items.ifFails: Validate the target on the server against an allow list
items.doNotTouch: Testing the redirect is active: only with authorization

items.title: Mixed content
items.question: Does any part of the page load without the padlock?
items.where: HTML of the home and one inner page
items.pass: Zero http:// resources on https:// pages
items.ifFails: Switch them to https://; on a CMS, search and replace in the database after a backup
items.doNotTouch: Search and replace without a backup

items.title: HTTPS and canonical host
items.question: Does every address land on one host with the padlock?
items.where: The http, https, apex and www responses
items.pass: http redirects to https; one of apex or www redirects to the other
items.ifFails: Configure the redirect at the host
items.doNotTouch: No HSTS preload until every subdomain has HTTPS

items.title: HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 and compression
items.question: Does the server use the fast protocols?
items.pass: HTTP/2 at least, and compression on
items.ifFails: Turn them on at the host or put a CDN in front

items.title: Cache and CDN headers
items.question: Is a cache or CDN layer working?
items.where: Cache-Control and cache status headers, on two loads in a row
items.pass: The second load shows a cache hit, or Cache-Control has a reasonable max-age
items.ifFails: Turn on page caching (VEL-05)
items.doNotTouch: Do not cache pages with sessions or form tokens

items.title: Time to first byte from outside
items.question: How long does the server take to start answering?
items.where: Time to first byte of the home, three runs
items.pass: Median under 0.8 s
items.ifFails: Work on hosting and cache (VEL-01)

items.title: Page weight and third parties (lab)
items.question: How heavy is the page, and how much of it comes from third parties?
items.where: A Lighthouse lab run on mobile
items.pass: Weight and the largest resources are measured and recorded; there is no universal threshold
items.ifFails: Follow VEL-02 and VEL-10

items.title: Visible plugins against vulnerability databases
items.question: Does any visible plugin have a known flaw?
items.where: Plugin and theme paths with ?ver= in the HTML
items.pass: No visible plugin with an unpatched known flaw
items.ifFails: Update or replace it (needs access: INT-06)
items.doNotTouch: Check each vulnerability database's terms before commercial use

items.title: Safe Browsing and blocklists
items.question: Do Google or mail blocklists flag the site?
items.pass: No warning and no listing
items.ifFails: Treat it as an incident; request a review afterwards

items.title: Search spam signals
items.question: Does Google show pages on the site that are not the owner's?
items.pass: No results foreign to the site
items.ifFails: Treat it as an incident; clean up and request removal

items.title: Privacy policy
items.question: Does the site publish a privacy policy for the data its forms collect?
items.where: Links on the home and in the footer
items.pass: A privacy policy page is linked and answers 200
items.ifFails: Publish one and link it next to every form

items.title: Indexability
items.question: Can Google show the site?
items.where: meta robots, the X-Robots-Tag header and robots.txt
items.pass: The home and key pages are indexable; robots.txt blocks neither the site nor its assets
items.ifFails: Remove the noindex in the SEO or reading settings
items.doNotTouch: A noindex on staging or on private pages is correct

items.title: robots.txt and sitemap
items.question: Does the site give Google a map of its pages?
items.pass: robots.txt declares a sitemap that answers 200 and lists real URLs
items.ifFails: Turn the sitemap on and declare it in robots.txt

items.title: Canonical URL
items.question: Does each page have one official address?
items.pass: A self-referencing canonical on the home and an inner page, on the host of EXT-17
items.ifFails: Fix it in the SEO settings; use one host

items.title: Title and meta description
items.question: Do the title and description say what the site is?
items.pass: The title leads with the topic in 50 to 60 characters; the description has 120 to 160
items.ifFails: Write them for each key page

items.title: Heading hierarchy
items.question: Does the page have one main heading?
items.pass: One h1 per page and no skipped levels
items.ifFails: Fix it in the page builder (sliders often add extra h1 elements)

items.title: Open Graph and Twitter card
items.question: Does a shared link show an image and a title?
items.where: og:title, og:description, og:image, og:locale and twitter:card
items.pass: All five present; an og:image of 1200 by 630 that answers 200
items.ifFails: Set a default share image in the SEO settings

items.title: Structured data
items.question: Is the organisation marked up for search engines without errors?
items.pass: No errors and one Organization entity
items.ifFails: Fix or remove inaccurate markup
items.doNotTouch: Do not add markup for content the page does not show

items.title: hreflang reciprocity
items.question: If the site has two languages, does Google know which version to show?
items.pass: Each version lists every version including itself, with x-default; the URLs answer 200 and are indexable
items.ifFails: Fix it in the SEO plugin or the template

items.title: Internal 404s and redirect chains
items.question: Are there broken links, or links that take detours?
items.where: Internal links of the home and key pages
items.pass: Zero internal 404s on key pages; redirects take one hop
items.ifFails: Fix the link or the redirect
items.doNotTouch: Changing permalinks without a redirect plan

items.title: Contrast and focus visibility
items.question: Is the text readable, and is the keyboard focus visible?
items.where: Lighthouse accessibility and a keyboard pass through the home
items.pass: No contrast failures; focus visible on every link and button
items.ifFails: Adjust colours and :focus-visible in a child theme
items.doNotTouch: Editing theme CSS without a child theme

items.title: Image alt text
items.question: Do images have a description for people who cannot see them?
items.pass: Zero content images without alt on the home
items.ifFails: Fill them in from the media library

items.title: Reflow and zoom
items.question: Can the site be used on a narrow phone and at 200% zoom?
items.where: A 320 px wide window and 200% zoom
items.pass: No horizontal scroll and no lost content
items.ifFails: Fix fixed widths and sliders

items.title: Form labels and target size
items.question: Are forms understandable, and are buttons easy to tap?
items.pass: Every field has a label; targets are 24 px or larger
items.ifFails: Fix the form
items.doNotTouch: Forms wired to a CRM: read the pre-change list first

items.title: Language and title
items.question: Does the page declare its language and have its own title?
items.pass: lang matches the content; the title is descriptive
items.ifFails: Set the language in the general settings and the theme

items.title: Direct contact
items.question: Can a visitor call or message in one tap from a phone?
items.where: The home: phone, mail and chat links
items.pass: A tel: or chat link on the home and in the footer
items.ifFails: Add a tap-to-call or chat link to the header and footer

items.title: Neglect signals
items.question: Does the site look abandoned?
items.where: The footer year, the period the home names and the date of the latest news in the feed
items.pass: The footer year and the latest news are current
items.ifFails: Update the footer, and publish news or hide the section

items.title: Main enquiry path
items.question: Can a visitor reach the main enquiry page from the home?
items.where: Links on the home (admissions, bookings or quotes)
items.pass: The home links to the main enquiry page
items.ifFails: Add it to the menu and the home

items.title: Messaging link number format
items.question: Do the chat buttons open the chat?
items.pass: Numbers in international format with no extra characters
items.ifFails: Rewrite the number in international format

items.title: Template leftovers
items.question: Are defaults from the theme or the CMS still published?
items.where: Sample pages, the default tagline and demo content
items.pass: No default content is published
items.ifFails: Remove or replace it

items.title: Legacy browser code
items.question: Is the code written for browsers nobody uses any more?
items.pass: No Internet Explorer conditional comments, old polyfills or Flash
items.ifFails: Remove them from the theme

items.title: Published mail domains receive mail
items.question: Can the published mail addresses receive mail?
items.where: mailto: links on the home and the contact page
items.pass: Every published domain has MX, or A or AAAA as the fallback, and no null MX
items.ifFails: Fix the address or the domain's mail records

items.title: Core integrity
items.question: Do the core files match the official release?
items.pass: No differences and no extra files
items.ifFails: Take a snapshot, then reinstall the core from the official package; unknown code opens the incident tab
items.doNotTouch: Do not delete anything before the snapshot

items.title: Malware patterns
items.question: Is there malicious code in the files?
items.pass: Zero matches beyond known legitimate plugins; zero PHP files in uploads
items.ifFails: Take a snapshot and open the incident tab
items.doNotTouch: Do not hand-clean a file that rewrites itself

items.title: mu-plugins and drop-ins
items.question: Is there code that runs silently on every request?
items.where: The must-use plugin folder and drop-in files
items.pass: Only legitimate ones from a known cache or object cache plugin, with headers
items.ifFails: Treat unknown ones as an incident
items.doNotTouch: Do not delete the drop-in of a real cache plugin

items.title: Autoloaded options
items.question: Does the database load hidden code or bulk on every page?
items.pass: Under 800 KB in total; no option holds code
items.ifFails: Inspect the largest options; code in an option opens the incident tab
items.doNotTouch: Do not delete core or active plugin options

items.title: Administrators and second factor
items.question: Who can administer the site?
items.pass: Only legitimate administrators, one per person, all with a second factor
items.ifFails: Note unknown administrators and treat them as an incident; do not delete them yet
items.doNotTouch: Do not delete users who author content: reassign it

items.title: Vulnerable and abandoned components
items.question: Is any plugin or theme flawed or abandoned?
items.pass: No component with an open known flaw; every one maintained
items.ifFails: Update or replace
items.doNotTouch: Deleting instead of deactivating; major updates without a backup

items.title: Backups include the database and restore
items.question: Is there a backup, and has anyone restored it?
items.where: The backup plugin or the host's backups
items.pass: Files and database included; a test restore worked this month; one copy off the host
items.ifFails: Make one before any other change
items.doNotTouch: Restoring over production as a test

items.title: Site Health
items.question: Does the CMS report critical problems?
items.pass: No critical items; recommendations noted
items.ifFails: Fix the critical items

items.title: Core, PHP and database versions
items.question: Are core, PHP and the database on supported versions?
items.pass: Core on the latest release; PHP with active support
items.ifFails: Plan the upgrades (VEL-04)
items.doNotTouch: Upgrading PHP without testing

items.title: Inactive plugins and unused themes
items.question: Are components installed but unused?
items.pass: No inactive plugin without a reason; at most three themes
items.ifFails: Deactivate first, then remove with a backup
items.doNotTouch: Deleting a plugin that stores data (forms, orders)

items.title: Dangerous settings
items.question: Are risky settings on?
items.where: General and discussion settings; config constants
items.pass: Open registration off; file editing disabled; debug off; comments moderated or closed
items.ifFails: Change the settings

items.title: Permalinks and outgoing mail
items.question: Do links and outgoing mail work properly?
items.pass: Post-name permalinks; mail sent through the domain's authenticated SMTP
items.ifFails: Configure SMTP
items.doNotTouch: Changing permalinks without a redirect plan

items.title: Application passwords and sessions
items.question: Are there hidden ways to sign in?
items.where: Application passwords and sessions of each user
items.pass: Only application passwords with a known use; sessions closed at the end
items.ifFails: Revoke unknown ones

items.title: Recently modified files
items.question: Is every recent file change explained?
items.where: Files modified in the last 30 days
items.pass: Every change is explained by an update or a logged change
items.ifFails: Investigate; an unexplained change opens the incident tab

items.title: Server rewrite rules
items.question: Do the .htaccess files hold only known rules?
items.pass: Only CMS, cache plugin and known custom rules
items.ifFails: Remove unknown rules after copying the file
items.doNotTouch: A syntax error returns 500 on the whole site

items.title: Config file hardening
items.question: Is the config file hardened and clean?
items.pass: Hardening constants present; fresh salts; no foreign code
items.ifFails: Add the constants with a copy of the file
items.doNotTouch: A syntax error gives a blank page

items.title: File permissions
items.question: Are file permissions neither open nor too tight?
items.pass: Folders 755, files 644, the config file 640 or 600, no 777
items.ifFails: Fix them with a backup
items.doNotTouch: Bulk changes without a backup

items.title: Child theme
items.question: Are theme customisations safe from updates?
items.pass: A child theme is active and the parent is unmodified
items.ifFails: Move the changes into a child theme
items.doNotTouch: Editing the parent theme

items.title: Third-party code snippets
items.question: Does every code snippet have an owner and a purpose?
items.pass: Every snippet has an owner and purpose; none with auto-login, eval or redirects; no non-breaking spaces
items.ifFails: Deactivate, do not delete
items.doNotTouch: Deactivating snippets marked as required without reading them; saving an HTML snippet as PHP

items.title: Cron hooks
items.question: Are all scheduled tasks known?
items.pass: Only hooks from the core and recognised active plugins
items.ifFails: An unknown hook opens the incident tab
items.doNotTouch: Deleting core hooks

items.title: Injected content in posts
items.question: Do posts or post meta hold injected scripts?
items.pass: No results beyond legitimate embeds
items.ifFails: Clean with a backup; an injection opens the incident tab
items.doNotTouch: Bulk database replacements without a backup

items.title: Transients and revisions
items.question: How much stale data is in the database?
items.pass: Counts measured and recorded
items.ifFails: Clean up during execution (VEL-11)

items.title: Orphan tables
items.question: Does every table belong to an active plugin?
items.pass: Every table is used by an active plugin
items.ifFails: Export, then drop with the owner's consent
items.doNotTouch: Dropping tables without knowing what they hold

items.title: Spam comments and pingbacks
items.question: Is the comment queue under control?
items.pass: Queue empty or moderated; pingbacks closed when unused
items.ifFails: Moderate the queue and close pingbacks

items.title: PHP version, OPcache and memory
items.question: Is the PHP setup current and tuned?
items.pass: Supported PHP; OPcache on; 256 MB of memory or more
items.ifFails: Change it in the panel and run the post-change matrix
items.doNotTouch: Upgrading PHP without the post-change matrix

items.title: Access log analysis
items.question: Do the access logs show successful requests to paths that should not exist?
items.pass: No successful hits on paths that should not exist; brute force answered with 401 or 403
items.ifFails: Investigate; an odd successful access opens the incident tab

items.title: Error log
items.question: Does the error log show repeated fatal errors?
items.pass: No repeated fatal errors
items.ifFails: Fix the cause

items.title: Server cron jobs
items.question: Are all the server's scheduled jobs known?
items.where: Cron jobs in the hosting panel
items.pass: Only your own jobs (the CMS cron, backups)
items.ifFails: A job that fetches remote code opens the incident tab

items.title: FTP, SSH and API tokens
items.question: Does every access account have a current owner?
items.pass: Only accounts and tokens with a current owner
items.ifFails: Remove or rotate them

items.title: Mail accounts and forwarders
items.question: Are there unknown mailboxes or forwarders?
items.pass: Only known accounts and forwarders
items.ifFails: Remove them; an unknown forwarder opens the incident tab

items.title: Disk usage
items.question: Is there room left on the disk?
items.pass: Under 80% used; old backups outside the web root
items.ifFails: Move or delete old copies once the last good one is known
items.doNotTouch: Deleting copies without knowing which is the last good one

items.title: Staging
items.question: Is there somewhere to test before production?
items.pass: A staging copy, or a subdomain to clone into
items.ifFails: Set one up
items.doNotTouch: Testing major updates in production

items.title: Elementor inventory
items.question: Is the page builder current and inventoried?
items.pass: Current version, valid licence, pages and templates listed
items.ifFails: Update with a backup
items.doNotTouch: Regenerating CSS or switching experiments without a backup

items.title: Avada inventory
items.question: Is the theme builder current and inventoried?
items.pass: Current licensed version; a child theme; shortcode and custom code inventory
items.ifFails: Update with a backup
items.doNotTouch: The classic editor adds paragraph tags inside raw HTML blocks: edit in text mode

items.title: Sliders and heavy premium plugins
items.question: Are premium plugins licensed and current?
items.pass: Current version with an active licence; sliders inventoried
items.ifFails: Renew the licence or replace the plugin
items.doNotTouch: Updating without a backup (sliders can come back empty)

items.title: Forms and CRM integrations
items.question: Does every form reach its destination?
items.pass: Every form has a known destination and a successful test send; personal data is kept for a set time
items.ifFails: Fix the destination
items.doNotTouch: Forms wired to a CRM: test with the action neutralised or in the CRM sandbox, never with real data

items.title: Caching plugins
items.question: Is there exactly one page cache layer?
items.pass: One page cache layer, with exclusions for pages with sessions or tokens
items.ifFails: Keep one and configure the exclusions
items.doNotTouch: Two layers that overwrite each other

items.title: External account ownership
items.question: Does the owner control every external account?
items.where: Analytics, tag manager, search console, social and mail workspace accounts
items.pass: Each account has a current owner, no former contractor keeps access, recovery and second factor are current
items.ifFails: Transfer ownership and remove old access

items.title: Account second factor and collaborators
items.question: Who can sign in to the platform account?
items.pass: Second factor on for the owner and every collaborator; only current people; the owner is the client
items.ifFails: Turn it on; remove old access; transfer ownership to the client
items.doNotTouch: Removing the only owner before transferring

items.title: External basics on a hosted platform
items.question: Are the external basics right?
items.pass: Same as EXT-01, EXT-04, EXT-05, EXT-06 and EXT-07
items.ifFails: Adjust what the platform allows (headers rarely)

items.title: Installed apps and injected scripts
items.question: Which apps and scripts load on the site?
items.where: The apps panel and the head of the HTML
items.pass: Only apps in use, each with an owner; no unknown injected code
items.ifFails: Uninstall with the owner; remove unknown code after saving its text
items.doNotTouch: Removing a pixel or chat the owner uses to sell

items.title: Platform-managed domain and TLS
items.question: Is the domain connected the way the platform documents?
items.pass: Domain connected as documented; TLS on; one version of the URL
items.ifFails: Reconnect following the platform's guide
items.doNotTouch: Changing DNS without the guide

items.title: Platform export
items.question: What happens if the platform closes the account?
items.pass: An export made, with its date
items.ifFails: Schedule a quarterly export to storage the owner controls

items.title: Static site deploy surface
items.question: Where is the risk on a static site?
items.where: The repository, the deploy provider and its environment variables
items.pass: Current collaborators; second factor on Git and the provider; headers configured; secrets in variables marked sensitive
items.ifFails: Rotate tokens; configure headers
items.doNotTouch: Production secrets in the repository

items.title: Self-hosted CMS other than WordPress
items.question: Does Joomla or Drupal follow the same model?
items.where: The CMS admin and the server
items.pass: Supported version, current extensions, tested backup
items.ifFails: Update with a backup
items.doNotTouch: Skipping major versions without the migration guide

items.title: Payment integration mode
items.question: Do card details pass through the site?
items.where: Payment settings and the gateway configuration
items.pass: Cards are entered in the gateway's iframe or after a redirect; test and live keys are separate
items.ifFails: Switch to the hosted or redirect mode
items.doNotTouch: Changing the gateway during sales hours

items.title: Checkout skimmer check
items.question: Is there code stealing cards at checkout?
items.where: Checkout HTML, payment plugin files and options
items.pass: No unknown scripts or card-capturing functions; payment plugin checksums match the release
items.ifFails: Open the incident tab at top priority and notify the gateway
items.doNotTouch: Do not clean anything before the snapshot

items.title: Cart and checkout cache exclusion
items.question: Are the cart and checkout excluded from the cache?
items.pass: Cart, checkout and account pages are always dynamic
items.ifFails: Exclude those routes and the store's session cookies
items.doNotTouch: Turning on page caching without exclusions

items.title: Customer data exposure
items.question: Is customer data protected?
items.pass: No export reachable by URL; sign-in attempts limited; order data visible by role only
items.ifFails: Block the files and limit attempts
items.doNotTouch: Deleting orders or customers

items.title: Orders and stock after a change
items.question: Do orders and stock still work after a change?
items.pass: A full test order in the gateway's sandbox, then the gateway back in live mode
items.ifFails: Fix it before publishing
items.doNotTouch: A test order with a real card; leaving the gateway in test mode

items.title: Store updates in staging
items.question: Are store updates tested first?
items.pass: Major store and gateway updates tested in staging with a test order
items.ifFails: Roll back with the backup
items.doNotTouch: A store database upgrade in production without a backup

items.title: Store account hygiene
items.question: Is the store account in the owner's hands?
items.where: Store users and apps with permissions
items.pass: The owner is the client; second factor on; apps reviewed
items.ifFails: Transfer ownership; remove old access
items.doNotTouch: Removing the only owner before transferring

items.title: Checkout performance
items.question: Does checkout load fast on a phone?
items.where: PageSpeed on the checkout URL, when it is public
items.pass: Measured on the first case; no threshold yet
items.ifFails: Defer third parties on the checkout
items.doNotTouch: Removing the gateway's script

items.title: Fraud and abuse controls
items.question: Is there a brake on fake orders and coupon abuse?
items.pass: Measured on the first case; no threshold yet
items.ifFails: Add limits and a challenge
items.doNotTouch: Blocking real customers

items.title: Legal pages
items.question: Does the store publish the minimum legal pages?
items.pass: The pages the trade requires are present, checked with the owner
items.ifFails: Treat it as a separate project
items.doNotTouch: Giving tax advice

items.title: Incident response
items.question: What happens if the site is compromised?
items.pass: Zero indicators in a second full pass; external and internal scanners clean
items.ifFails: Iterate, or hand over to a cleanup service
items.doNotTouch: The credential rotation order (SEG-02)

items.title: Credential rotation order
items.question: In what order are the credentials changed?
items.where: CMS, hosting, database, tokens and integrations
items.pass: Everything rotated with the environment inert, and logged with dates
items.ifFails: Repeat with the site isolated
items.doNotTouch: Rotating salts live without notice; rotating before isolating the site

items.title: Firewall layer
items.question: Is there a filter in front of the site?
items.where: CDN firewall, security plugin or the host's web firewall
items.pass: One layer active for the site's risk
items.ifFails: Turn on a CDN firewall or the plugin firewall
items.doNotTouch: CDN script rewriting and auto-minify break builder scripts; a plugin firewall starts in learning mode

items.title: Named accounts and least privilege
items.question: Does every person have their own account with the role they need?
items.pass: One user per person; administrators only for those who administer; no former contractor keeps access
items.ifFails: Create accounts, reassign content, lower roles
items.doNotTouch: Do not delete a shared account that authors content: change its password and reassign

items.title: Second factor for administrators
items.question: Do administrators need more than a password?
items.pass: Every administrator enrolled with an authenticator app and recovery codes stored; then required for the role
items.ifFails: Enrol people one at a time
items.doNotTouch: Making it required before everyone is enrolled

items.title: Disable file editing
items.question: Can code be edited from the dashboard?
items.pass: The theme and plugin editors are gone from the dashboard
items.ifFails: Add DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT with a copy of the file
items.doNotTouch: A syntax error gives a blank page

items.title: XML-RPC blocked when unused
items.question: Is XML-RPC closed?
items.pass: xmlrpc.php answers 403 from outside (EXT-11)
items.ifFails: Block it
items.doNotTouch: Jetpack and the mobile app use it: confirm first

items.title: REST user enumeration limited
items.question: Can the API list users?
items.pass: EXT-03 passes from outside
items.ifFails: Turn on the security plugin's option or add a small filter
items.doNotTouch: Do not disable the whole REST API

items.title: Security headers
items.question: Does the browser get the security instructions?
items.where: Server config, CDN or security plugin
items.pass: EXT-01 passes; the Content-Security-Policy ran in Report-Only with no console errors first
items.ifFails: Add one header at a time and verify
items.doNotTouch: HSTS preload before every subdomain has HTTPS; a strict policy with page builders

items.title: Update policy
items.question: How and when are updates applied?
items.where: The updates screen and auto-update settings
items.pass: Security and minor updates current; major updates tested in staging
items.ifFails: Apply them with a backup
items.doNotTouch: Major updates in production

items.title: 3-2-1 backups with a tested restore
items.question: Are there copies in three places, and has a restore been tested?
items.where: The backup plugin and the host's backups
items.pass: A copy with the database on the host and off it; a test restore recorded
items.ifFails: Configure and test
items.doNotTouch: Restoring over production as a test

items.title: Minimum monitoring
items.question: Will anyone notice if something happens?
items.where: Uptime monitor, security alerts, search console, Safe Browsing, DMARC reports and expiry dates
items.pass: All six signals configured to a mailbox someone reads
items.ifFails: Configure them

items.title: Former contractors and migration plugins
items.question: Does a former contractor still have access?
items.where: Users, hosting, external accounts and plugins
items.pass: No out-of-date third-party access; no export or migration plugin installed
items.ifFails: Remove access; uninstall the plugins
items.doNotTouch: Do not delete the user who authors the content: reassign it

items.title: Mail authentication hardening
items.question: Is the domain's mail protected against spoofing?
items.pass: SPF without +all; DKIM verified; DMARC p=none with rua, then quarantine after a month of clean reports
items.ifFails: Publish or correct the records
items.doNotTouch: Do not change MX; no p=reject without a month of reports

items.title: Sign-in brute force protection
items.question: Can passwords be guessed without limit?
items.where: The security plugin or the host's firewall
items.pass: An attempt limit is on; logged attempts get 403 or 429
items.ifFails: Turn it on
items.doNotTouch: Locking out your own address: add the exception

items.title: Salt rotation with notice
items.question: Were the internal keys changed after the incident?
items.pass: New salts, with a date; users told they must sign in again
items.ifFails: Rotate them
items.doNotTouch: Rotating without notice signs everyone out at once

items.title: No PHP execution in uploads
items.question: Could an uploaded file run as code?
items.pass: A .php file placed in uploads answers 403 (tested in staging)
items.ifFails: Add the rule
items.doNotTouch: On Nginx the rule goes in the server config

items.title: Directory listing off
items.question: Can folders no longer be listed?
items.pass: EXT-10 passes from outside
items.ifFails: Add Options -Indexes
items.doNotTouch: A syntax error returns 500

items.title: Hidden version and readme
items.question: Is the version no longer visible from outside?
items.where: Child theme or security plugin; readme.html
items.pass: EXT-02 passes
items.ifFails: Remove the generator tag and block readme.html
items.doNotTouch: Editing the parent theme

items.title: Server response, PHP and server cache
items.question: Does the server answer fast?
items.where: Hosting, PHP and the server cache
items.pass: Supported PHP, OPcache on, cache on, median time to first byte under 0.6 s with the cache
items.ifFails: Work through VEL-04, VEL-05 and VEL-06
items.doNotTouch: Changing PHP without testing

items.title: Images: format, dimensions, lazy loading
items.question: Do the images weigh too much?
items.pass: WebP or AVIF with declared dimensions; the main image preloaded (VEL-08)
items.ifFails: Convert with a backup; resize the oversized ones
items.doNotTouch: Lazy-loading the main image; converting without a backup

items.title: Render-blocking CSS and JS
items.question: Do files block the first paint?
items.pass: No critical blocking; design intact after the post-change matrix
items.ifFails: Defer or load conditionally
items.doNotTouch: Minifying and combining blind

items.title: PHP upgrade with a compatibility test
items.question: Can PHP be upgraded without breaking anything?
items.where: The hosting PHP selector and each plugin's tested-up-to version
items.pass: Supported PHP with no fatal errors
items.ifFails: Upgrade in staging first; replace the incompatible plugin
items.doNotTouch: Upgrading in production without staging

items.title: Page cache
items.question: Are pages stored ready to serve?
items.pass: EXT-19 shows a hit; forms and session pages excluded; one page cache layer
items.ifFails: Install and configure it; purge after each change
items.doNotTouch: Caching pages with tokens; two cache plugins together

items.title: Object cache
items.question: Are repeated queries kept in memory?
items.where: Redis or Memcached at the host
items.pass: Object cache on and verified in Site Health
items.ifFails: Turn it on if the host allows it
items.doNotTouch: A foreign object cache drop-in (INT-03)

items.title: CDN
items.question: Does a network serve the site closer to the visitor?
items.pass: EXT-18 shows HTTP/2 or 3 and Brotli; static files hit the CDN cache
items.ifFails: Configure it and test forms and menus
items.doNotTouch: Script rewriting; auto-minify; caching HTML with sessions

items.title: Main image preload
items.question: Does the main image load first?
items.pass: LCP improves and the main image is not lazy-loaded
items.ifFails: Preload it with fetchpriority high
items.doNotTouch: Lazy-loading the main image

items.title: Fonts and icon fonts
items.question: Do fonts and icons add weight and block the page?
items.where: The head and the theme CSS
items.pass: Two families at most, preloaded, with font-display swap; icon fonts subset
items.ifFails: Self-host, subset and preload
items.doNotTouch: Removing a font the design uses

items.title: Third-party scripts
items.question: How much do chats, maps, videos and tag managers load?
items.pass: Third parties under 200 ms of blocking (measured per site)
items.ifFails: Defer to interaction; use facades for videos; keep one tag manager
items.doNotTouch: Removing a script the owner uses to measure

items.title: Database cleanup
items.question: Does the database keep data nobody needs?
items.pass: Autoload under 800 KB; expired transients at zero; revisions capped
items.ifFails: Clean up with a backup
items.doNotTouch: Deleting core options or unknown tables

items.title: Heartbeat and cron tuning
items.question: Do the dashboard and internal tasks waste resources?
items.pass: Configured, and the tasks still run
items.ifFails: Heartbeat at 60 s; a real server cron every 5 minutes
items.doNotTouch: Disabling the CMS cron without a server cron

items.title: Protocols and compression
items.question: Does the server use HTTP/2 or 3 and compress?
items.pass: EXT-18 passes
items.ifFails: Ask the host, or use a CDN

items.title: Redirect chains and internal 404s
items.question: Do pages take detours or get lost?
items.pass: VIS-09 passes
items.ifFails: Make each redirect one hop; replace broken links
items.doNotTouch: Changing permalinks without a plan

items.title: DOM size and sliders
items.question: Does the page have too many elements or a heavy slider?
items.pass: DOM under the Lighthouse warning; a slider with one or two slides
items.ifFails: Simplify it in the builder with the owner
items.doNotTouch: Removing the slider without a replacement

items.title: Elementor performance settings
items.question: Is Elementor set to load the minimum?
items.pass: The four performance options on, with no visual change; local fonts
items.ifFails: Turn on one at a time, with the post-change matrix after each
items.doNotTouch: Turning them all on at once

items.title: Avada performance settings
items.question: Is Avada set to load the minimum?
items.pass: Settings applied with no visual change
items.ifFails: Apply one at a time
items.doNotTouch: Two lazy-loading systems at once

items.title: Slow queries and outgoing calls
items.question: Do queries or outgoing HTTP calls slow the server?
items.pass: No repeated query over 0.05 s; no outgoing HTTP call on every load
items.ifFails: Replace or configure the responsible plugin; add an object cache
items.doNotTouch: Leaving Query Monitor installed

items.title: Emojis, embeds, dashicons, jQuery Migrate
items.question: Does the page load things nobody uses?
items.pass: None of those in the public HTML; no console errors
items.ifFails: Disable them and test
items.doNotTouch: Removing jQuery Migrate while an old plugin needs it

items.title: Before and after measurement
items.question: How much did it improve, measured the same way?
items.where: The verification protocol: same tools, three runs, median, mobile and desktop apart
items.pass: The before and after table is complete
items.ifFails: Measure again
items.doNotTouch: Comparing lab numbers with field numbers

items.title: Uptime monitor
items.question: Will anyone know if the site goes down?
items.pass: Monitor on; the month's availability recorded
items.ifFails: Configure it; when the site went down, write the cause and fix in the report

items.title: Update cadence
items.question: Are updates applied on time without breaking anything?
items.pass: Security and minor updates current; major updates tested
items.ifFails: Apply them; roll back with the backup if something breaks
items.doNotTouch: Major updates in production

items.title: Monthly restore test
items.question: Does this month's backup restore?
items.where: The backup tool and a test subdomain
items.pass: A successful restore, with its date
items.ifFails: Reconfigure the backup
items.doNotTouch: Restoring over production

items.title: Breach notification readiness
items.question: Does everyone know whom to tell about a data leak?
items.where: The written agreement with the owner
items.pass: A written, signed procedure: who tells whom, and by when
items.ifFails: Write it

items.title: Weekly malware scan
items.question: Is the site scanned every week?
items.where: A security plugin scan and an external scanner
items.pass: Clean scan, or findings resolved
items.ifFails: Assess; an indicator of compromise opens the incident tab
items.doNotTouch: Deleting a finding without understanding it

items.title: Monthly users and second factor review
items.question: Did anyone join or leave the dashboard this month?
items.pass: No unauthorised changes; every administrator has a second factor
items.ifFails: Remove or correct; an unknown administrator is an incident
items.doNotTouch: Deleting authors

items.title: Weekly logs and alerts review
items.question: Does anyone read the alerts?
items.where: Alert mail; the access log once a month
items.pass: Alerts read and noted; no unknown sign-ins
items.ifFails: Investigate and block addresses; an odd successful access is an incident

items.title: Monthly Core Web Vitals
items.question: Is the site still fast?
items.where: PageSpeed on mobile (EXT-08) and time to first byte (EXT-20)
items.pass: Values equal to or better than the baseline, or the cause found
items.ifFails: Find the cause (a new plugin, new images, a cache turned off)

items.title: Domain, certificate and reputation
items.question: Is anything about to expire, or is the site flagged?
items.where: Registry, TLS, Safe Browsing and a site: search
items.pass: Nothing expires within 60 days; no warnings
items.ifFails: Renew; a warning or spam opens the incident tab

items.title: Monthly report
items.question: Does the owner see what was done this month?
items.pass: Sent on the agreed date, with availability, updates, scans, the restore test and speed
items.ifFails: Send it
items.doNotTouch: Promising what was not measured

items.title: DMARC reports
items.question: Is anyone sending mail in the domain's name?
items.pass: Reports read; the policy matches what they show
items.ifFails: Adjust the records
items.doNotTouch: Moving to reject without a clean month

items.title: Monthly forms test
items.question: Do the forms still deliver?
items.pass: A marked test send arrives
items.ifFails: Fix it (INT-12, INT-36)
items.doNotTouch: Sending real data to a live CRM

preChange.text: A full backup of files and database, restored as a test on a subdomain or locally. A backup nobody restored does not count.
Staging if it exists; otherwise one change at a time with the way back written down.
A low-traffic window agreed with the owner.
A written way back: which file or setting is put back, and how.
The owner told what will be touched, and when.
The list of what will be tested afterwards (the post-change matrix).

postChange.how: A real send from each public form, marked as a test; for forms wired to a CRM, with the action neutralised or in the CRM sandbox
postChange.pass: It reaches its destination and shows in the form's panel

postChange.how: A test order with the gateway in test mode
Sign in with a test account and its second factor
The home, the main enquiry page, a news item and a page with a slider
postChange.pass: They look as before, with no raw shortcodes

postChange.how: A real phone, or developer tools at 375 px
postChange.pass: No horizontal scroll; the menu works

postChange.how: Purge the plugin, server and CDN caches
A private window, on the www host when the site uses it
postChange.pass: It looks the same as when signed in

postChange.how: The developer tools console on the home
Reset the password of the test account

steps.text: Site isolated: public access blocked (maintenance mode, or deny all except your own address)
Written ticket to the host: isolate without deleting, preserve logs and a snapshot, and keep the site offline until you confirm
Owner told what happened and what you are doing, and asked not to change passwords yet
Full snapshot of files, database and access and error logs, stored apart from the site
Indicators recorded with path, date and hash (INT-01 to INT-05, INT-14, INT-15, INT-19 to INT-21, INT-26, INT-28 to INT-30)
Evidence that holds the attacker's live secrets kept in an encrypted local folder, out of any cloud or repository
Files: PHP in uploads, unknown mu-plugins and drop-ins, modified core, recently changed files, rewrite rules
Database: autoloaded options with encoded code, fake administrators, foreign cron hooks, posts with scripts
Users: unknown administrators, application passwords, sessions
Hosting: server cron jobs that fetch remote code, FTP and SSH accounts, API tokens, mail forwarders
DNS and mail: changed MX, odd TXT records, new subdomains
Plugins disguised as legitimate ones, and migration or export plugins
Path decided: restore a clean backup from before the infection, or clean in place
Inventory of legitimate content created after the backup date, to put back by hand
Admin lockout applied: every administrator password replaced by a random hash and every session cleared
Clean backup restored (files and database), or the site cleaned in place
Second full pass over the six layers counts zero indicators
Legitimate content created after the backup put back from the inventory
Real passwords rotated with the environment inert, in order: salts, administrators, hosting panel, FTP and SSH, database, API tokens, application passwords, integrations
Migration and export plugins uninstalled
Hardening list applied, starting with named accounts, second factor, file editing, XML-RPC, sign-in limits, uploads and access left by former contractors
Core, plugins and themes updated
Attacker addresses blocked, and what the restore does not touch rotated (hosting panel, SSH, system cron, FTP, forwarders)
Second full pass of the internal and external lists: zero indicators, scanners clean, no Safe Browsing warning, no spam in a site: search
Post-change matrix passed (forms, sign-in, key pages, phone, anonymous)
Site republished, and the host asked to lift any network block
Review requested from the search engine if there was a warning
Two reports written: a technical one with the timeline and a one-page plain one
Daily scan and sign-in review during the first week after republishing
